---
title: "Research Integrity"
---

## Controlled statement classes

Research statements are labeled as observation, partial observation, inference, proposal, validation result, rejection, absence in the checked source, unverified dependency, or justified non-applicability.

The label answers an epistemic question; it is not a quality score. `OBSERVED_PARTIAL` can be the correct and most rigorous conclusion.

## Non-conflation

- physical forcing is distinct from sensing and prediction;
- structural coupling is distinct from statistical association;
- failure, service loss, and human consequence are separate variables;
- viability, reachability, recovery, and resilience are not synonyms;
- technical feasibility does not establish institutional adoption;
- mathematical form generation does not establish comprehension or decision impact.

## Reproducible claims

A computational claim must identify its model contract, experiment record, code version, inputs, environment, random seed where applicable, numerical tolerance, test results, and output provenance.

Known failures, null results, sensitivity, and unresolved uncertainty remain visible in the research record.
